verdict.rationale: Fern's own documented core capability is producing official, type-safe, idiomatic SDKs in up to nine languages (TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, Ruby, PHP, C#) from an API spec, with first-class pagination helpers, and the CLI publishes those SDKs. The evidence does not show a first-party SDK for building against Fern's own platform API, even though an OpenAPI spec exists at buildwithfern.com/openapi.json. Missing for 10: evidence of an official SDK for Fern's own API, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and agent-specific SDK guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Type-safe SDKs in multiple languages, including TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, Ruby, PHP, and C#
Fern generates SDKs in 9 languages from a single API specification
Cursor-based and offset-based pagination are first-class.
Fern is an SDK generator and documentation platform that produces idiomatic, type-safe client libraries in nine languages
